Autodesk

Autodesk 3ds Max

Autodesk 3ds Max supports 3D modelling, animation and rendering for design visualisation and media.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Model a presentation scene

Use the selected model, asset hierarchy and scale. In the intended Autodesk 3ds Max preview, model a presentation scene; the visible result is a composed scene with geometry and camera framing visible. Review object identity, silhouette and missing assets before accepting or exporting it.

Stage cameras and animation

Start from the approved scene state, materials and motion intent. In the intended Autodesk 3ds Max preview, stage cameras and animation; the visible result is a lighting, animation or effects preview with changed controls exposed. Review timing, material response, collisions and visual continuity before accepting or exporting it.

Render a reviewed sequence

Begin with the reviewed cameras, render settings and delivery format. In the intended Autodesk 3ds Max preview, render a reviewed sequence; the visible result is a bounded presentation sequence or image comparison. Review frame content, colour, legibility and output specification before accepting or exporting it.
